metadata.description: PsyReaSFX is a high-performance sound asset browser, audition, waveform, metadata, region, collection, REAPER insertion, and Transfer workflow.

version.name: 0.9.0-beta7.9
version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Correctly clears the active AI session after local recall reaches 100%, so the completion status closes normally. - Restores immediate Load next 120 paging from the in-memory candidate pool. - Runs REAPER waveform peak building through Init, Run and Finish even when Init returns zero, fixing long-file waveform failures.

version.name: 0.9.0-beta7.8
version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Uses the AI API only once to expand the natural-language query; candidate metadata is no longer uploaded for remote reranking. - Removes the AI relevance column and background reranking state while preserving similarity scores for Find Similar Sounds. - Loads every additional 120-result page immediately from the local Top-2400 candidate pool.

version.name: 0.9.0-beta7.7
version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Replaces repeated AI progress bars with one compact phase status line. - Keeps up to 2400 local candidates and lets users append the next 120 results on demand. - Compresses candidate metadata and model output to ID/score pairs for faster, more reliable reranking.

version.name: 0.9.0-beta7.6
version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Accelerates AI local candidate recall with a cheap combined-text prefilter before weighted field scoring. - Compiles AI-expanded query terms once per search instead of repeating normalization for every catalog row. - Adds a 100,000-asset capacity regression test while keeping REAPER responsive with a bounded frame budget.

version.name: 0.9.0-beta7.5
version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Disables DeepSeek's default thinking mode for structured AI-search planning and reranking requests. - Accepts valid JSON wrapped in prose, Markdown fences, or text content blocks. - Automatically retries once when DeepSeek JSON Output returns empty or malformed content.

version.name: 0.9.0-beta7.4
version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Fixes AI search failing with resource_busy while waveform precaching, cache verification, catalog snapshots, or directory maintenance is active. - Gives AI search and connection tests an independent job resource and scans a stable asset-array snapshot. - Keeps completion, failure, and cancellation cleanup independent from catalog-maintenance jobs.

version.name: 0.9.0-beta7.3
version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Safely migrates legacy catalog journals by field name instead of entering read-only protection with field_mismatch. - Gives DPAPI API-key storage an independent atomic write path so catalog read-only state cannot block key saving. - Includes the current DeepSeek Flash / V4 Pro presets, unclipped AI settings layout, and inline save feedback.

version.name: 0.9.0-beta7.2
version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Updates the DeepSeek presets to the current deepseek-flash and deepseek-v4-pro API model IDs, with automatic migration from the legacy names. - Fixes right-edge clipping in AI settings by placing labels above the full-width endpoint, model, and API-key fields. - Shows API-key save success or exact failure inline and verifies that the encrypted DPAPI secret file was created.

version.name: 0.9.0-beta7.1
version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Uses the top search field as the shared input for normal and AI semantic search. - Enter always confirms normal local search; the gold AI button or Ctrl+Shift+F directly starts AI semantic search with the same text. - Removes the extra AI query popup and moves provider, model, API key, connection testing, privacy, and usage guidance into Settings. - Keeps AI candidate recall scoped to the active library, folder, collection, and status without literal pre-filtering by the natural-language query.

version.name: 0.9.0-beta7
version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Adds a separate AI semantic search entry point with a gold toolbar button and Ctrl+Shift+F shortcut. - Supports DeepSeek, OpenAI, and custom OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoints and models. - Recalls up to 120 candidates locally, then sends only bounded filename and metadata fields for semantic reranking; audio and full paths are never uploaded. - Encrypts the API key for the current Windows user with DPAPI and keeps it out of normal configuration, backups, logs, and command lines. - Adds AI relevance results, progress, cancellation, connection testing, timeout cleanup, and safe local fallback.

version.name: 0.9.0-beta6.1
version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Adds the optional PsyReaSFX Neural Similarity package to this ReaPack repository on Windows x64. - Discovers the ReaPack-managed component under REAPER's Data directory while preserving legacy manual installs. - Keeps rebuildable embeddings, HNSW index, capabilities and jobs outside the ReaPack package.

version.name: 0.9.0-beta6
version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Expands optional neural similarity to common WAV sample rates and bit depths, AIFF, FLAC, MP3, and M4A. - Uses in-memory downmixing and resampling without creating converted audio copies. - Uses FFmpeg when available for OGG, Opus, WavPack, and CAF, and skips individual decode failures safely. - Keeps the neural component optional and transparently falls back to the existing 15-feature search.

version.name: 0.9.0-beta5
version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Adds optional local EfficientAT embeddings with persistent HNSW recall and hybrid acoustic reranking. - Keeps the neural component optional and transparently falls back to the existing 15-feature search. - Supports visible progress, cancellation, incremental cache reuse, and exact filtering for current results. - Protocol v1 activates only when the complete search scope is 32 kHz PCM16 WAV.

version.name: 0.9.0-beta4.5
version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Preserves full-file reverse preview when menus, shortcuts, or auto-preview request the zero position. - Includes the Beta 4.4 playhead seek stabilization and forward/reverse position mapping fixes.

version.name: 0.9.0-beta4.4
version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Prevents the preview playhead from flashing at the waveform start before a requested seek is applied. - Keeps the requested UI position until SWS confirms the seek, with a bounded timeout fallback. - Aligns forward, reverse, and selection-preview position mapping.

version.name: 0.9.0-beta4.3
version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Builds and reuses a full-library similarity index during idle time for near-instant repeated searches. - Uses exact bucket-bound pruning and a fixed Top-200 heap while preserving exhaustive ranking results. - Adds a contextual red-yellow-green Similarity bar and percentage column.

version.name: 0.9.0-beta4.2
version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Reopens UCS suggestions on every search without stealing the input focus, caret, or Backspace editing. - Clears stale free-text queries when opening UCS directories so displayed counts match their results. - Resolves legacy CatIDs through the official UCS catalog for consistent parent, child, and CatID counts.

version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Prevents completed libraries and Watch Folder checks from being mistaken for interrupted scans. - Accepts only explicit, recent foreground checkpoints and retires ambiguous legacy checkpoints. - Treats closing the PsyReaSFX window as a clean stop while preserving genuine crash recovery.

version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Finalizes the 0.7 browsing, audition and Transfer workflow as Stable. - Opens the first folder level only after a deliberate toolbar click. - Keeps hover-driven cascading for libraries, sources and indexed subfolders.

version.changelog: - Fix Chinese/CJK track names not rendering. - Draw UTF-8 text through Windows GDI into the persistent offscreen LICE bitmap. - Rebuild bitmap alpha after GDI drawing so JS_Composite remains flicker-free. - Preserve multiline fitting, font selection, and playback hiding. - 修复中文/CJK 轨道名不显示的问题；改用 Windows GDI UTF-8 离屏绘制，并继续通过 LICE/Composite 防闪烁合成。

source.file: psy_Video Item Filename Overlay_视频素材文件名覆盖显示.lua

version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Change the default font to Microsoft YaHei UI for Chinese text support. - Keep existing saved font choices unchanged. - Continue live track-name display, multiline fitting, and playback hiding. - 默认字体改为 Microsoft YaHei UI，确保中文轨道名可正常显示；已保存的用户字体设置不会被覆盖。

source.file: psy_Video Item Filename Overlay_视频素材文件名覆盖显示.lua

version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Display the current track name instead of the source video filename. - Track-name edits are reflected automatically while the transport is stopped or paused. - Keep multiline fitting, playback/record hiding, and existing font settings. - 改为显示视频 Item 所在轨道的轨道名称；修改轨道名后自动更新，并保留多行排版与播放隐藏逻辑。

source.file: psy_Video Item Filename Overlay_视频素材文件名覆盖显示.lua

version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Hide the overlay completely during Play and Record. - Suspend overlay redraw work while transport playback is active. - Restore the filename overlay immediately after Stop or Pause. - Keep multiline fitting and extension-free filenames while stopped. - 播放和录音期间完全隐藏文件名覆盖层，停止或暂停后立即恢复，从根源避免滚动播放闪烁。

source.file: psy_Video Item Filename Overlay_视频素材文件名覆盖显示.lua

version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Correct the font-width estimate so long filenames wrap earlier instead of incorrectly staying on one line. - Allow emergency shrinking below the configured preferred minimum, down to 5 px, to preserve the complete filename. - Dynamically reduce title reserve and side margins as the item becomes smaller. - Keep the v1.3 paint-synchronized composite renderer to avoid playback-scroll flicker. - 修复自动换行触发过晚和 Item 稍微变窄就不显示的问题；必要时自动缩小到 5px，并动态压缩顶部留白与左右边距。

source.file: psy_Video Item Filename Overlay_视频素材文件名覆盖显示.lua

version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Fix playback-scroll flicker by drawing to a persistent LICE bitmap instead of directly into the Arrange View DC. - Composite after REAPER's own paint cycle using js_ReaScriptAPI. - Throttle composite WM_PAINT updates to reduce contention during continuous scrolling. - Preserve the complete balanced multi-line filename layout from v1.2. - 修复播放滚动时字体闪烁：改为持久 LICE 位图，并在 REAPER 自身绘制完成后统一合成。

source.file: psy_Video Item Filename Overlay_视频素材文件名覆盖显示.lua

version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Replace single-line ellipsis with complete multi-line filename display. - Prefer natural line breaks at underscores, hyphens, spaces and other separators. - Balance line lengths and center the entire text block horizontally and vertically. - Adapt font size, line count and line spacing to the visible item dimensions. - 改为完整多行显示文件名，优先在分隔符处换行，并让整段文字在 Item 主体区域内水平、垂直居中。

source.file: psy_Video Item Filename Overlay_视频素材文件名覆盖显示.lua

version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Replace LICE/Composite rendering with direct Arrange View GDI drawing for better reliability. - Add original-filename and Take-name fallbacks for video-source detection. - Keep minimum readable font size and use ellipsis instead of silently hiding long names. - Report when no video item can be detected. - 改用直接 GDI 绘制，增加视频源识别兜底，并在名称过长时使用省略号而不是直接隐藏。

source.file: psy_Video Item Filename Overlay_视频素材文件名覆盖显示.lua

version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Avoid repeatedly rebuilding the font cache when the default settings are used. - Keep extension-free adaptive filename drawing, toolbar toggle state, and companion settings. - 修复默认设置下字体缓存重复重建的问题。

source.file: psy_Video Item Filename Overlay_视频素材文件名覆盖显示.lua

version.author: Psysia
version.changelog: - Initial ReaPack publication. - Draw video source filenames directly inside visible Arrange View items. - Hide file paths and extensions. - Adapt font size to the visible item width and height. - Add toolbar toggle state and companion persistent settings. - 首次发布；在视频 Item 内直接显示不带扩展名的源文件名，并根据缩放后的可见区域自适应字号。
